changes.summary: Import versioned and discovery JSON manifests, validate them offline, review each output and safely download a bounded concurrent batch with typed Origin headers, cancellation and partial-failure handling. Show output format and extension in every download summary, and safely create missing destination directories only when the confirmed download begins. Expose direct output-format editing and a batch-wide MP4 choice; show metadata loading counts and a concurrent progress panel with reusable active slots.
Prepare the embedded JSON Schema validator dependency and record batch workflow documentation.
changes.justification: Only private media-get packages, dependency manifests, notices and documentation change; the public cli Go API and module path are preserved.
